image.data-name: A cinematic wide shot of a warm approachable small business owner woman in mint green sweater working on laptop at cafe counter, surrounded by floating social media post mockups and product photos and AI graphics and analytics icons around her. The scene is set in a modern cozy coffee shop interior with warm wood tones and plants. Soft natural window light illuminates the space, featuring a blue and mint green color palette with warm natural tones, creating an optimistic aspirational mood. Photorealistic style, highly detailed..jpg
